acceptanceFindings.speechDenialMessage: PASS: user denial produced the expected inline guidance without an app crash
acceptanceFindings.cause: After the user enabled Speech Recognition, macOS TCC refused the microphone prompt because the responsible main app lacked com.apple.security.device.audio-input. The native helper already had it.
acceptanceFindings.resolution: Signing policy now requires JIT plus audio input on the main app, audio input on dictation only, JIT on other Electron helpers and no process entitlements on frameworks/libraries. New signed candidate and native acceptance required.
